title: repo
description: Per-repo constants: the landmines, waits, gates, stubs, and protected paths specific to one codebase. Lives at <repo>/.process/repo.yaml (or a CLAUDE.md section where a file is overkill). Names and labels only — never secrets.

version.description: Schema version this file was written against, e.g. "1.0".

repo_name.description: Label for the repo this file describes. Optional in a template; required in a real instance.

gotchas.description: Recurring landmines that trip up a fresh contributor or agent in this repo, so a delegate doesn't have to rediscover them.

id.description: Short stable identifier for this gotcha.

description.description: What trips people up and why.

evidence_pointer.description: Where to look to confirm it (a path, a command, a doc section).

never_wait_checks.description: Checks that are known to be quota-dead, rate-limited, or otherwise structurally unable to resolve in a useful timeframe — excluded from the done-decision rather than waited on.

name.description: The check's name as it appears wherever checks are reported.

reason.description: Why it's quota-dead or otherwise unwaitable (e.g. a shared quota exhausted, a known-broken external dependency).

matcher.description: A pattern that identifies this check programmatically, if one exists.

verification_gate_extensions.description: Extra done-criteria this repo adds on top of the pack's default gate list for a given work class.

work_class.description: The work class being extended, e.g. a CI/workflow change, a deploy-path change, a mobile feature.

extra_requirements.description: Additional evidence this repo requires before that work class counts as done.

stub_patterns.description: Local-only stub/mock markers that must never reach a real commit, and what identifies them.

name.description: Short label for the stub pattern.

marker.description: A grep-able pattern (comment tag, filename convention, flag name) that identifies the stub in a diff.

description.description: What the stub replaces and why it exists locally.

removal_criterion.description: The condition under which the stub must be reverted before commit/merge.

protected_paths.description: Paths that must never be edited without explicit sign-off: generated code, vendored deps, infra applied elsewhere.

override.description: What's required to touch it anyway, if anything.

standing_review_responses.description: Pre-authorized replies to predictable automated-reviewer objections, so a delegate can respond with reasoning instead of silently complying against this repo's own policy.

trigger_pattern.description: The predictable objection an automated reviewer raises.

response.description: The standing, pre-approved reply, stated with its reasoning.

rationale.description: Why this repo's policy overrides the reviewer's default suggestion.

adversarial_pre_merge_review.description: This repo's configuration for the verification-gates adversarial-pre-merge-review gate: who performs the independent review, and any risk criteria this repo adds on top of the pack's base list (deploy-path, security-adjacent, data-migration, explicitly-flagged).

reviewer_identity.description: The independent agent/tool that performs the adversarial pass for this repo. Must name a genuinely different agent/tool than whatever authors changes here — never the authoring agent/tool re-invoked in a fresh context.

extra_risk_criteria.description: Additional conditions, on top of the pack's base risk criteria, that trigger the mandatory pre-merge adversarial review for this repo.
